All 263 supplied units were considered as context. This response disposes only of the 66 selected concerns, retains both original questions, and does not complete reconciliation of the other batches.

The repeated synthetic mappings to gift.question, second.duty, unit 0 and unit 262 establish accounting links only. Unit 262 completes the physical-verification example with additional supporting identity proof where appropriate; it does not supply a general exception or gift rule.

The existing-device exception remains retained: existing clients need not rebind already bound devices. It does not remove login authentication requirements or requirements governing new registration, additional passkeys, recovery or replacement devices.

The authentication timing remains retained: as soon as practicable and no later than 8 July 2027, with immediate implementation expected of large internet brokers. The supplied text does not define large internet brokers or mechanically determine practicability and immediacy.

The during-period and after-period scenarios remain distinct. Transitional use of existing authentication, including SMS OTP in the specified illustration, does not establish indefinite OTP acceptability. Enhanced monitoring and immediate suspension or restriction upon suspicious or potentially fraudulent activity remain retained.

Passkeys and bound devices are examples, with platform suitability, two-factor authentication, robust verification alternatives, certification, identity verification, recovery and synchronization controls requiring separate consideration. The source does not provide complete mechanical performance criteria.

The general limit of three passkeys and/or three devices retains the adequate-assessment route for additional registrations. Session-timeout provisions retain their assessment, ongoing-monitoring and justified longer-timeout qualifications.

Notification, monitoring, surveillance, incident response, reporting, client awareness, predeployment testing, rollout, client support, anticipated-delay notification, management oversight and internal-control duties remain independently retained. Authentication alone does not account for them.

The five listed missing dependencies have null source hashes. Referenced circulars, guidelines, FAQs and FIDO materials are not fully supplied. Their applicable editions and effects remain unresolved; identifying a reference does not establish its contents.
